rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for exactness and emphatic focus, especially before the thing being highlighted.

example.english: That is precisely the book I wanted.
example.jyutping: zing3 zing3 hai6 ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 go2 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this specifically when precisely means doing or saying something accurately, rather than simply stressing it.

example.english: You need to record the time precisely.
example.traditional: 你要準確咁記低個時間。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 zeon2 kok3 gam3 gei3 dai1 go3 si4 gaan1

rows.note: Use this in spoken emphasis meaning “exactly” or “that is precisely it,” especially in an agreement or correction.

example.jyutping: zau6 hai6 nei5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1
